messages:
mike_h: CI flakes on rerank evals for the quantized-4bit bringup. ndcg@10 drops ~0.07 vs float16 baseline, and runner logs show 'skipping normalization' intermittently. anyone seen this?

ci-bot: CI failed: rerank_eval_job #542 — step=compute_metrics — error=ValueError('NaN in ndcg calculation') — logs: /ci/artifacts/542/metrics.log

sophia: i've seen NaNs before when embeddings aren't normalized before cosine. do you have a small reproducer?

mike_h: i ran a local reproduce with rl-infer:ci-202404. steps:```bash
python -m evals.runner --suite rerank_mteb --model ./models/llama2-70b-q4.pt --seed 42 --output out.json
``` got intermittent NaNs and big ndcg deltas.

aj: two quick suspects: 1) missing l2 normalization before cosine similarity, 2) dcg denominator off-by-one / wrong log base (we used ln once by accident). also check whether ranks are 0-indexed somewhere.

devon: last time we had a similar regression it was because ideal_dcg was computed with rank starting at 0, which inflates normalization. also our runner didn't set deterministic seeds for numpy/torch in the CI job, so results can vary.

sophia: pushing a tiny patch that enforces normalization and fixes dcg formula: use log2(rank + 1) with rank starting at 1. also added explicit seeding in evals/runner: np.random.seed(seed); torch.manual_seed(seed); random.seed(seed). i'll link shortly.

mike_h: can you paste the patch snippet?

sophia: snippet:```python
# metrics.py
def dcg(scores):
    # scores already sorted by predicted rank (1-indexed)
    return sum((2**s - 1) / math.log2(i + 1) for i, s in enumerate(scores, start=1))

# before scoring
embs = embs / np.linalg.norm(embs, axis=1, keepdims=True)
```

aj: nice. also add an assertion in compute_ndcg that ideal_dcg > 0 to avoid divide-by-zero/NaN.

mike_h: applied locally, re-running CI now.

ci-bot: Job rerun queued: rerank_eval_job #543 (triggered by mike_h).

eval-bot: rerank eval complete: ndcg@10 float16=0.587, q4=0.580 (after metric patch). previous q4 under old metric=0.515. TL;DR: metric bug + missing norm was the main delta.

mike_h: huge improvement. thanks. next steps: unit test with synthetic ranking (known ideal dcg) to catch formula regressions. also add a small smoke MTEB-like retrieval subset to CI so bringups fail fast.

sophia: i'll add tests in evals/test_metrics.py and a smoke suite rerank_smoke in CI (fast, 50 queries). will also add a dashboard panel 'ndcg_regression' to the evals grafana so onboarding PRs show deltas.

aj: :thumbsup: recommend gating model onboarding PRs on ndcg delta < 0.03 vs pinned baseline and adding an 'embedding drift' check (mean cosine difference between float16 and quantized embeddings) — trigger warning if > 0.05.

devon: created PR #1298 with metric fix + tests + deterministic seeding. CI passed on my machine. leaving followups: add test vectors, update docs.

mike_h: notes captured: - enforce l2 norm before similarity - fix dcg normalization (log2, 1-indexed) - add ideal_dcg assertion - deterministic seeds in runner - small MTEB-like smoke suite in CI - dashboard + gating policy for onboarding PRs - embedding drift alert (cosine delta)

sophia: i'll update onboarding.md and the evals runbook. dropping the PR link in #pr-updates when ready. :eyes:

mike_h: thanks all, will watch the dashboard tomorrow and close the bringup ticket if stable.
